g.text: CL65.6 the engine asks its types: the architecture
a box and a point, two families
its list from step 4, empty at step 9
The flow, and the class chart's
The builder, the keys, the frame,
draws every picture; a test draws
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: The types come first, then each kind is moved onto them, and a rule test's list shrinks to nothing.
